explore-analyzer.title: Find the dip
explore-analyzer.prompt: Lengthen or shorten the antenna until the SWR on 3.6 MHz is 1.2:1 or better.
hints: The dip is above your frequency. Which way moves resonance down?
explore-analyzer.success: About 8% longer moves the dip from 3.9 down to 3.6 MHz.

explore-fault.title: Something's wrong
explore-fault.success: An open connection reflected everything. Clean, tight connectors brought the SWR back to 1:1.

explore-loss.title: The lying meter
explore-loss.prompt: Increase the feedline loss until the station meter reads 1.5:1 or better, even though the antenna hasn't changed.
explore-loss.success: The antenna is still 3:1, but the lossy line eats the reflected power on the way back.
